info.headline: Cancellation of Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Greater Brisbane and Surrounds
info.description:
Severe thunderstorms are no longer affecting the Southeast Queensland area (east of Dalby from Rainbow Beach to Stanthorpe). This warning is now cancelled.
54 mm of rainfall recorded at Cooroy in the 30 minutes to 4:34 pm AEST. 4 cm hailstones reported near Yarraman at around 1:10 pm AEST.
info.instruction: Emergency services advise people to: * Never drive, walk, play or ride through floodwater. It is dangerous. * Stay away from storm water drains. * Stay away from fallen powerlines. * Drive slowly and never drive through floodwaters. If the road is flooded or damaged, go another way. * For storm help, call the SES on 132 500 or download the free SES Assistance QLD app.
